description: Bowling Green, KY (November 15, 2023) – Republican State Representative for Kentucky’s 17th District Dr. Robert Duvall launched his reelection campaign today to continue serving the people of Warren County in the State House. Dr. Duvall, a Bowling Green optometrist, is a proven conservative leader with the experience and relationships to deliver results in Frankfort.

title: Dr. Robert Duvall Launches State House Reelection Campaign - Dr. Robert Duvall for State Representative
